name: balloons
title: Balloons
description: A celebration effect: glossy balloons float up and away, or a few words rise as letter balloons, over the page or contained in one element.
author: Artur Bień <https://github.com/arturbien>

// ---- upstream: src/balloonSvg.ts ----
// The balloon drawing and its filters, line for line. Labs changes: the
// file is typed (upstream: `// @ts-nocheck`), and the SVG ids carry a
// per-release suffix (`filter0_f_102_49-<id>`), so two releases at once,
// or another SVG on the page with the same exported ids, never share a
// filter. The private custom properties carry the component prefix
// (upstream: --balloon-color, --light-color, --balloon-width,
// --balloon-height). The markup is built only when balloons() runs.
const defaultBalloonColor = "#84A332";
const defaultLightColor = "#C0F381";

const balloonColorProperty = "--balloons-color";
const lightColorProperty = "--balloons-light-color";
const widthProperty = "--balloons-width";
const heightProperty = "--balloons-height";

export const balloonDefaultSize = {
  width: 233,
  height: 609,
};
export const createBallonElement = ({
  balloonColor,
  lightColor,
  width,
  id,
}: {
  balloonColor: string;
  lightColor: string;
  width: number;
  id: string;
}) => {
  const balloon = document.createElement("balloon");

  balloon.innerHTML = balloonSvgHTML(id);
  Object.assign(balloon.style, {
    position: "absolute",
    overflow: "hidden",
    top: "0",
    left: "0",
    display: "inline-block",
    isolation: "isolate",
    transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
    backfaceVisibility: "hidden",
    opacity: "0.001",
    transform: "translate(calc(-100% + 1px), calc(-100% + 1px))",
    contain: "style, layout, paint",
    transformOrigin: `${width / 2}px ${width / 2}px`,
    willChange: "transform", // Improves rendering performance in Safari
  });

  balloon.style.setProperty(balloonColorProperty, balloonColor);
  balloon.style.setProperty(lightColorProperty, lightColor);
  balloon.style.setProperty(widthProperty, width + "px");
  balloon.style.setProperty(heightProperty, (width * 609) / 223 + "px");

  return balloon;
};
